blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Safety alignment has enabled large language models to reliably refuse harmful requests directly, yet the same request distributed across a multi-turn conversation still succeeds far too often. This brittleness has a mechanistic root: Alignment is shallow, with safety behavior concentrated in a model's first few output tokens, and existing defenses inherit the weakness, supervising the surface form of the response without ever giving the model an explicit safety decision to learn. We take the opposite view of shallowness: if a short span determines the trajectory of an entire response, that span is the highest-leverage place to intervene, and the defender can occupy it first. We propose Assess $\to$ Decide $\to$ Respond, a framework in which the defender assesses the user's intent, commits to an explicit, parseable safety decision, and only then generates a reply conditioned on it, with the commitment trained by reinforcement learning at the payload turn. Because the decision is a token span, the reward can be a rule: a self-verified reward checks the committed label against the conversation's known nature, requiring no judge and no annotation, while the same format also supports an LLM-as-judge reward over a graded decision space with safe redirection. Across two model families and fourteen benchmarks spanning safety, utility, and helpfulness, our defenders achieve the strongest multi-turn safety in a controlled comparison, maintaining their lead in safety while preserving utility at a modest cost to helpfulness. A per-token KL analysis and interventional probes confirm why this works: training concentrates its effect on the brief deliberation that sets a response's trajectory, and the decision committed there is a causal control point. The very shallowness attackers exploit becomes the mechanism of defense.
blocks.zh: 安全协调使大型语言模型能够可靠地直接拒绝有害的请求,但在整个多回合对话中分发的同一请求仍然往往成功。 这种脆性有一个机械根:对接很浅,安全行为集中在模型最早的少数输出符上,而现有的防御力继承了弱点,监督反应的表面形式而从未给模型一个明确的安全决定来学习. 我们对浅度持相反的看法:如果一个短的跨度决定了整个反应的轨迹,那么这个跨度是干预的最高杠杆地,捍卫者可以先占领. 我们提议评估美元-决定美元-答复,在这个框架中,辩护人评估用户的意图,承诺作出明确、可解析的安全决定,然后提出答复条件,承诺在有效载荷转弯处通过强化学习加以培训。 由于决定是象征性的跨度,奖励可以是一条规则:自我验证的奖励对照对话的已知性质检查承诺的标签,不需要法官或注释,而同样的格式也支持LLM-asjudge奖励一个等级化的决定空间,安全地重定向. 在整个两个模范家庭和14个涵盖安全、效用和帮助度的基准中,我们的捍卫者在有控制的比较中实现了最强的多回合安全,在安全中保持领先地位,同时以适度的代价保持效用,以取得帮助。 一种可切入的 KL 分析和干预探测器可以证实它为什么起作用: 训练将它的效果集中在确定反应轨迹的简短考虑上,而所承诺的决定是一个因果控制点. 极浅的攻击者利用它成为防御机制。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed across an ever-widening range of applications, ensuring that they behave safely has become as important as advancing their capabilities. Safety alignment, training models to refuse harmful requests while remaining helpful on benign ones, is now a standard stage in the development of every frontier model ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Sharma et al., 2025 ; Cunningham et al., 2026 ) . This investment has paid off in the single-turn setting: successive rounds of safety training and red-teaming have made aligned models substantially robust to single-turn jailbreaks, from handcrafted prompts to optimized adversarial suffixes ( Bai et al., 2022 ; Zou et al., 2023 ; Ganguli et al., 2022 ) , and a harmful request posed directly is now refused with high reliability. Multi-turn dialogue, however, remains far less protected. In a single-turn attack, the malicious intent is evident in the prompt itself, while in a multi-turn conversation, the attacker can conceal it, distributing the request across turns so that each message appears innocuous ( Russinovich et al., 2024 ; Weng et al., 2025 ; Alobaid et al., 2026 ) . Under such attacks models fail far more often, and human red-teamers continue to defeat defenses that report near-perfect single-turn robustness ( Li et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2026 ; Song et al., 2026 ; Rahman et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 由于大型语言模型被部署在范围不断扩大的应用程序中,确保它们的安全行为已经变得与提高它们的能力一样重要。 安全协调,拒绝有害请求的培训模式,同时对良性要求仍然有所帮助,目前是开发每一个前沿模式的标准阶段(欧阳等,2022;夏尔马等,2025;Cunningham等,2026)。 这一投资在单回合制中得到了回报:连续几轮安全培训和红队使对接模式基本健全到单回合越狱,从手动提示到优化对抗后缀(Bai等,2022;Zou等,2023;Ganguli等,2022;),现在直接提出的有害请求被高可靠性地拒绝。 然而,多回合对话的保护程度仍然低得多。 在一转攻击中,恶意意图在即时本身中明显可见,而多转对话中,攻击者可以隐藏,将请求分出转弯,使每条消息显得无恶意(Russinovich等,2024;Weng等,2025;Alobaid等,2026). 在这种攻击模式下,更经常地失败,人类红队继续击败那些报告近乎完美单转稳健性的防御(Li等,2024;Feng等,2026;Song等,2026;Rahman等,2025.).

blocks.en: A growing line of defenses targets this setting: supervised fine-tuning on adversarial dialogues ( Rahman et al., 2025 ) , preference optimization over safe and unsafe replies ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2025 ) , reinforcement learning with judge-based rewards ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , representation-level interventions ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , and inference-time prompting that asks the model to analyse the user’s intention before answering ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Beneath their differences, the training-based methods share a dependency: each needs an oracle in the loop, whether a harmfulness classifier, a preference labeler, or a guard model, to say what a safe response looks like, and each supervises the form of the response that oracle prefers. That dependency is costly and fragile. Judges disagree with one another on a substantial fraction of individual samples (§ 4.2 ), so a reward built on one imports its errors into training and entangles the training signal with the evaluation metric. And because the model is only ever shown what safe replies look like, it never learns an explicit safety decision that a rule, rather than a model, could check.
blocks.zh: 越来越多的防线针对这一背景:监督对对抗性对话的微调(Rahman等,2025年),优于安全和不安全的答复(Jiang等,2024年;Yan等,2025年),以法官奖励加强学习。 (Guo等人,2025年),代表级发言 (Lu et al.,2025),和推论时间提示要求模型在回答之前分析用户的意图(Zhang等,2025b.). 在他们的差异下,以训练为基础的方法共享一个依赖性:每个方法在循环中都需要一个甲骨文,无论是有害分类器,偏好标签器,还是一个后卫模型,来说明安全反应是什么样子,每个方法都监督甲骨文所偏爱的反应形式. 这种依赖性是昂贵和脆弱的。 法官在相当一部分的个别样本上意见不一(第4.2节),因此,建立在某一份样本上的奖励将错误输入培训,并将培训信号与评价指标纠缠在一起。 并且因为模型只显示安全答案的外形,所以它从未得知一个明确的安全决定,即一个规则而不是一个模型可以检查.

blocks.en: A second observation says where such a decision belongs. Safety alignment is known to be shallow : an aligned model departs from its base almost exclusively over the first few output tokens ( Qi et al., 2024a ) . Safety training, in effect, teaches the model to open with a refusal, and once a response opens compliantly the aligned distribution collapses back to the base model’s. This is why prefilling an affirmative prefix defeats refusal ( Vega et al., 2023 ; Andriushchenko et al., 2025 ) , and it is how a multi-turn attacker wins: steer the conversation until the locally natural opener is compliant, and by the payload turn the refusal is gone before anything harmful has been written. Prior work reads this shallowness as a defect and tries to deepen alignment ( Qi et al., 2024a ) . We read it as a map. If a short span at the front of the response sets the trajectory of everything that follows, that span is the highest-leverage place to intervene, and the defender can occupy it first, not with an implicit refusal prefix but with an explicit commitment.
blocks.zh: 第二项意见指出,这种决定属于何处。 据了解,安全调整很浅:一个统一模式几乎完全偏离其基础,仅次于第一批产出标志(Qi等人,2024a)。 实际上,安全培训教导模型以拒绝方式打开,一旦响应按规定打开,对齐的发行就会倒向基模。 正因为如此,预先填充正前缀才能击败拒绝(Vega等,2023;Andriushchenko等,2025;),而一个多回合攻击者如何取胜:引导对话直到当地自然开放者符合要求,通过有效载荷转弯,在写出任何有害内容之前,拒绝就已消失. 先前的作品将这种浅浅理解为缺陷并试图加深对齐(Qi等,2024a.). 我们把它看成地图 如果在反应前方有一个短的跨度设定了接下来所有事物的轨迹,那么该跨度是干预的最高杠杆地,捍卫者可以首先占据它,而不是暗中拒绝前缀,而是有明确的承诺.

blocks.en: We instantiate this idea as Assess → \to Decide → \to Respond . At every turn the defender briefly assesses the user’s underlying intent, commits to a parseable safety decision, and only then writes a reply conditioned on that decision. The commitment is the heart of the design. It is externalized : a token span in the model’s own output that a rule can read. It is binding : because it precedes the reply within the same generation, the reply is produced conditioned on it, so changing the commitment changes the response. And it is early : it occupies exactly the trajectory-setting positions that shallow alignment leaves exposed. We train the commitment with reinforcement learning, rewarding only the final turn of each conversation, where the attack delivers its payload and the defense must hold.

blocks.en: Externalizing the decision is what makes the reward simple. Training dialogues are grown from seed prompts whose nature is known in advance, so every trajectory carries a ground-truth label for free, and the reward reduces to a string comparison: refuse on conversations grown from harmful seeds, comply on benign ones. No judge, no annotation, no model in the loop: a verifiable reward for conversational safety in the spirit of RLVR ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ) . Where a judge is available, the same format supports the prevailing judge-scored design ( Inan et al., 2023 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2025 ) , with a graded decision space that adds safe-redirect . And because the decision conditions the reply, training the decision span alone is enough to change end-to-end behavior.
blocks.zh: 将决定外部化是使奖励变得简单的原因. 训练对话是从种子提示开始的,而种子提示的性质是事先知道的,因此每个轨迹都带有免费的地面真实标记,奖励被缩小为字符串比较:拒绝来自有害种子的对话,服从良性的声音。 无评委,无注释,循环中无模型:以RLVR的精神对对话安全进行可核查的奖励(Shao等,2024;Lightman等,2024). 在有法官可用的情况下,同样的格式支持流行的法官分数设计(Inan等,2023;Guo等,2025;Ding等,2025),其分级决定空间会增加安全定向. 而因为决定条件 答复,培训 整个决定 仅 足以改变端到端的行为。

blocks.en: Experiments on two model families ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) and fourteen benchmarks spanning safety, utility, and helpfulness show that both variants match or exceed every baseline trained on the same data, that the lead holds under six independent judges, and that the self-verified variant achieves this with no judge in the loop and a recipe that runs unchanged across backbones. Utility is preserved, at a modest cost in helpfulness that we quantify. We summarize our contributions as follows: • A multi-turn defense framework: Assess → \to Decide → \to Respond turns shallow alignment from a vulnerability into an explicit, trainable control point for safety alignment. • Two complementary rewards: a self-verified reward that checks the committed label against the conversation’s known nature, requiring no judge and no annotation, and an external LLM-as-judge reward over a graded decision space with safe redirection. • Comprehensive experiments and analysis: the strongest multi-turn safety in a controlled comparison across two model families, fourteen benchmarks, and six judges, achieved without per-backbone tuning, with KL and interventional analyses confirming that the defense operates through the committed decision.

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: We train a multi-turn defender via reinforcement learning. At each turn, the defender follows an Assess → \to Decide → \to Respond pipeline: it first assesses the user’s underlying intent, then commits to an explicit decision, and finally generates a response conditioned on that decision. For policy optimization, we explore two reward formulations: an external reward model that judges response safety and a rule-based self-reward that verifies the committed decision against the conversation’s ground-truth nature. Figure 1 provides an overview of our framework.
blocks.zh: 我们通过强化学习来训练一个多回合的捍卫者. 在每一回合,辩护人都遵循评估__决定_\响应管道:首先评估用户的基本意图,然后承诺作出明确的决定,最后根据该决定做出回应。 为了优化政策,我们探索两种奖励模式:一种是法官应对安全的外部奖励模式;另一种是基于规则的自我奖励,以核实承诺的决定与对话的地面真实性。 图1概述了我们的框架。

For reward computation, we consider two options: an external reward model that judges whether the response is jailbroken, or a rule-based self-reward that checks the final turn’s committed label against the conversation’s ground-truth nature. RL gradients are applied only to the final turn.

blocks.en: 2.1 Assess → \to Decide → \to Respond
blocks.zh: 2.1 评估___决定___响应

blocks.en: At every turn, the defender first assesses the user’s underlying intent, then commits to an explicit decision, and only then generates its response conditioned on that decision. The decision space consists of comply and refuse. When training with the external reward model, we augment it with a third option, safe-redirect, which allows the defender to deflect harmful requests without an outright refusal. Concretely, the system prompt elicits a single generation of the form Assessment: the user’s true underlying intent, and whether fulfilling the request could cause real harm Decision: COMPLY / REFUSE / SAFE-REDIRECT Response: the reply to the user We write y t = ( d t , a t ) y_{t}=(d_{t},a_{t}) for the decomposition of turn t t into its deliberation d t d_{t} , spanning everything up to and including the decision line, and its reply a t a_{t} . Two properties of this format carry the rest of the method. First, the decision is externalized: it is a token span in the model’s own output, and can therefore be read by a rule rather than judged by a model. Second, it is binding: because it precedes the reply within the same generation, the reply is produced conditioned on it, which is what makes it possible to train the decision alone. The two system prompts that elicit this format are shown verbatim in Appendix D .

Prior RL-based defenses score the defender’s response with an external judge — a harmfulness classifier on harmful conversations, and typically a refusal-phrase or helpfulness proxy on benign ones. 0,&\text{otherwise},\end{cases} (3) where the condition a T ≠ ∅ a_{T}\neq\varnothing serves as a completeness guard: a turn whose deliberation exhausts the per-turn token budget and leaves no reply is penalized. Without this guard, the reward admits a degenerate optimum: emit refuse and never answer. It is precisely this guard that requires every commitment to be backed by an actual reply. Note also that the self-verified setting excludes safe-redirect from the decision space: in harmful conversations, both refuse and safe-redirect constitute defensible commitments. Therefore, a rule that reads only the committed label cannot designate a unique target, rendering the reward signal ambiguous. We therefore restrict this setting to the binary decision space and leave the three-way space to the external judge, which evaluates the reply itself.

blocks.en: The full gradient treats the whole generation as the action, so the reply style adapts jointly with the decision; the partial gradient confines learning to the deliberation and largely preserves the base model’s reply style. That the partial gradient works at all rests on the binding property: the reply is generated conditioned on the committed decision, so training the decision alone changes end-to-end behavior. The same property is what lets the reward read only the label. The rule cannot by itself rule out a reply that contradicts its label, and we add no content check, for two reasons. First, a decoupled policy could not score well, since safety is judged open-endedly on the user-facing reply alone, so any gap between label and reply would appear as a lower safe rate, and none does. Second, the binding holds by construction: a forced refuse yields a safe reply in every case even before training (§ A ). Consistent with both, the emitted Decision label is positively correlated with every external judge’s verdict, at a level comparable to inter-judge agreement (§ 4.2 ).

blocks.en: The harmful pool mixes five multi-turn attack families instantiated over the same AdvBench ( Zou et al., 2023 ) behaviors: SEMA ( Feng et al., 2026 ) , Crescendo ( Russinovich et al., 2024 ) , foot-in-the-door (FITD) ( Weng et al., 2025 ) , Echoing ( Li et al., 2024 ) , and Hidden Intention Streamline ( Li et al., 2024 ) . Behaviors are split into disjoint train and test sets, and each training behavior is assigned one family uniformly at random. The benign pool comprises multi-turn dialogues from UltraChat-200k ( Ding et al., 2023 ) , matched to the harmful conversations in surface form and depth so that neither correlates with harmfulness. The two pools are mixed in equal proportion to constrain over-refusal; ablations over the mixing ratio are in § 3.3 . We use HarmBench-13B classifier ( Mazeika et al., 2024 ) as the external reward model. For each reward variant we report two conditions: unaligned , our system prompt applied to the untrained base weights; and aligned , the same prompt after RL. The former isolates the framework and the gap between them is the contribution of training.

blocks.en: 3.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 reports the full comparison. Our method attains the highest average safe rate on both backbones and leads every individual safety column. The two panels differ in how that lead is composed. On Llama3.1-8B the baselines separate sharply, with X-Boundary near-saturating AdvBench while most others fall far behind, so our margin comes from the suites the strongest baseline handles worst, above all the human-crafted MHJ attacks. On Qwen3-8B the baselines sit much closer to each other, and our advantage is a uniform lead across all five suites. These gains come at modest cost elsewhere: our models remain competitive on MT-Bench and match the field on utility, which is scored without the chat template and is therefore largely insensitive to safety training ( Qi et al., 2024a ) (Figure 2 ); the only visible price is somewhat higher over-refusal, as expected from a stricter decision policy. Appendix B plots the safety–helpfulness trade-off, on which our models sit at the favorable end of the frontier, and Appendix E.2 restates Table 1 with 95% confidence intervals.
blocks.zh: 表1报告进行了全面比较。 我们的方法在两根骨干上都实现了最高的平均安全率,并领导着每个单独的安全柱. 这两个小组在如何组成这一领导方面各不相同。 在Llama3.1至8B上,基线截然相去甚远,有X-边界近饱和的Adv Bench,而其他大多数则远远落在后面,因此我们的距离来自套房 最强基线手柄最差,尤其是人类制造的MHJ攻击。 在Qwen3-8B上,基线坐得相去甚远,我们的优势是在所有五个套房都有一个统一的领先. 在其他地方,这些收益成本不高:我们的模型在MT-Bench上仍然具有竞争力,在功用上与球场相匹配,在没有聊天模板的情况下得分,因此对安全培训基本不敏感(Qi等,2024a) (图2),唯一可见的价格比较严格的决策政策预期的要高一些。 附 录 B 设计了安全-帮助取舍,我们的模型位于有利的边界端,附录E.2以95%的置信间隔重述表1。

blocks.en: Two comparisons locate the source of the gain. First, we run our system prompt on the untrained base weights ( unaligned ) and again after RL ( aligned ). The prompt alone improves on the base model but falls well short of the trained result, so structured deliberation helps in its own right and is no substitute for the reward. Second, the table holds the data fixed and varies only the method, so the remaining differences are attributable to the training objective rather than to the training set. Reaching the baseline numbers on Qwen3-8B did require a per-method configuration change, none of which transfers from the Llama setting (Appendix C ); our own recipe is unchanged across backbones.

blocks.en: 3.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 3.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: We ablate one factor at a time on the Llama backbone, holding everything else fixed. Two ablations alter the training recipe: per-turn reward distributes the outcome-level reward across individual turns, and partial gradient restricts the gradient from the full response to the decision span. Two alter the framework: w/o decision drops the Decision line, leaving Assess → \rightarrow Respond, and w/o assessment drops the Intent line, leaving Decide → \rightarrow Respond. Both framework arms use the external reward, since a defender that emits no label gives the self-verified reward nothing to check (§ 2.3 ). A final ablation varies the harmful-to-benign ratio of the training mixture. Figure 3(a) shows the first four: the horizontal lines are our two full models and each bar is one modification, read against the line for its reward. Figure 3(b) shows the mixture sweep.
blocks.zh: 我们一次放弃一个因素 在Llama骨干上, 持有其他的一切固定。 两次擦伤改变了培训方法:每轮奖励将结果一级的奖励分给个人,部分梯度限制梯度,使其无法对决定期间作出充分反应。 两项修改了框架:w/o决定放弃了决定线,留下评估 \\\右翼反应,w/o评估放弃了意向线,留下决定 \\右翼反应。 这两种框架武器都使用外部奖励,因为没有任何标签的维权者不会给自我核实的奖励任何检查(第2.3节)。 最终的衰减会改变训练混合物的有害与受益比率。 图3(a)显示前四:横向行是两个完整的型号,每个行是一改一改一取,与行相取取取其赏. 图3(b)显示混合扫描情况。

blocks.en: The two recipe changes fail in opposite directions. Per-turn reward loses safety while driving over-refusal to its lowest level, since spreading an outcome-level signal across every turn erodes the safety decision and pushes the policy toward indiscriminate compliance; partial gradient buys robustness at the cost of moderately higher over-refusal, with answer quality untouched. The framework ablations show where the defense lives. Removing the decision is the most damaging change in the study: safety falls on every suite and, under human red-teaming, drops below the undefended base model, even though the assessment, the reward and the data are all left intact. Removing the assessment costs far less and shows up mainly as a loss of calibration, with over-refusal rising because the commitment is placed less precisely. Both removals refuse less overall, which lifts answer quality slightly. The commitment, not the deliberation that precedes it, carries the defense; Appendix A.1 reaches the same conclusion by intervention rather than removal.
blocks.zh: 两种食谱的改变在相反的方向都失败了. 反向奖励在把反向过度推向最低水平的同时会失去安全性,因为把结果一级的信号传播到每一个转弯都会削弱安全决定并促使政策走向不加区别的遵守;部分梯度以略高的反向过度代价购买稳健性,而答案质量没有受到影响。 框架浮出水面 说明防御部队的住址 删除这个决定是研究中最具破坏性的改变:安全落在每间套房上,在人红队下,会下降至无防守的基础模型下,尽管评估,奖励和数据都完好无损. 消除评估费用要少得多,而且主要表现为校正失败,由于承诺的投放不够准确,因此反弹过多。 两种清除都拒绝总的减少,这略微提高了质量。 承诺,而不是承诺之前的审议,都包含辩护;附录A.1通过干预而不是删除得出同样的结论。

blocks.en: The training mixture only sets where the policy sits on the frontier, since automated safety is saturated throughout: oversampling harmful dialogues buys red-teaming robustness at a steep cost in over-refusal and answer quality, while oversampling benign dialogues trims over-refusal only marginally. We keep the balanced mixture.

blocks.en: 4 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 分析

blocks.en: 4.1 Shallow Alignment
blocks.zh: 4.1 浅色对齐

blocks.en: Figure 4: Per-token KL divergence across aligned, unaligned and base models.
blocks.zh: 图4:不同对齐、不对齐和基准模型的平移KL差异。

blocks.en: Safety alignment in current LLMs is known to be shallow: the aligned distribution departs from the base model almost exclusively over the first few output tokens, and this concentration is precisely what prefilling and decoding-parameter exploits target ( Qi et al., 2024a ) . Rather than treating shallowness as a pathology to be eliminated, our framework repurposes it: the intervention remains concentrated at a small number of trajectory-setting positions, but the fragile refusal prefix is replaced by an explicit control structure whose decision field gates the subsequent response. The setup is detailed in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 众所周知,当前LLMs中的安全配比很浅:配比分布几乎完全偏离了基础模型,几乎完全超越了最初几个输出符,而这种集中恰恰是预填和解码参数开发目标(Qi等,2024a.). 我们的框架不把浅度当作一种需要消除的病理,而是将其重新用于:干预仍然集中在少数确定轨迹的位置上,但脆弱的拒绝前缀被一个明确的控制结构所取而代之,其决定领域为随后的反应打开了大门。 设置详见附录C.

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows a pattern qualitatively different from shallow alignment. D KL ( aligned ∥ unaligned ) D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\text{aligned}\,\|\,\text{unaligned}) is not concentrated at the first few tokens; instead, training-induced divergence is spread across the assessment phase preceding the decision token, peaks in its vicinity, and gradually vanishes thereafter as the two models converge. This is by construction: training reshapes how the model assesses intent and commits to a decision, so its influence is distributed over the entire deliberation rather than compressed into an opening refusal prefix; once the decision is emitted, the response is largely determined and the two distributions gradually converges. In contrast, both the aligned and unaligned models diverge sharply from the base model at the very first position and remain separated throughout, reflecting the fact that the framework defers commitment while the base model begins answering immediately. Together, these observations confirm that our design relocates the safety-relevant probability mass from a superficial refusal prefix to the assessment-decision phase, retaining the benefits of an early intervention while removing the single-point attack surface that shallow alignment creates. Appendix A further verifies the same claim by direct intervention, showing that overwriting the committed decision moves reply safety in both directions and that training hardens the reply behind the commitment, not merely the label.
blocks.zh: 图4显示的格局在质量上不同于浅接。 DKL( 对齐了 QQ 不对齐 ) D_{\mathrm{ KL}} (\text{accesst}\,}\text{unaccesst}} ) 不集中在最初的几个标志; 相反, 训练引发的分歧在决定标志之前的评估阶段被分散, 在它的附近出现峰值, 然后随着两种模型的汇合而逐渐消失. 这就是通过构建:培训重塑模型如何评估意图并致力于决定,因此其影响分布在整个审议过程中,而不是被压缩成一个开口拒绝前缀;一旦决定被发布,反应基本被确定,两个分布逐渐趋同. 相比之下,统一模式和不统一模式在最初的位置就与基准模式大相径庭,而且始终相互分离,反映出框架推迟承诺,而基准模式则立即开始回答。 这些观测结果共同证实,我们的设计将与安全相关的概率质量从表面拒绝前缀迁移到评估-决定阶段,保留了早期干预的好处,同时去除浅接所形成的单点攻击表面. 附 录 通过直接干预进一步核实同一说法,表明推翻承诺的决定行动对两个方向的安全都作出了回应,培训使承诺背后的答复更加坚定,而不仅仅是标签。

blocks.en: 4.2 Correlation Between LLM Judges
blocks.zh: 4.2 LLM之间的关联 法官

blocks.en: Because safety is scored by an LLM judge, the choice of judge is a potential confound: an improvement measured under one judge need not survive under another. Rather than assuming judges are interchangeable, we quantify their agreement and discuss what it implies for interpreting our results. The setup is detailed in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 由于安全性由LLM法官评分,法官的选择是一个潜在的混乱:一个法官衡量的改善不需要在另一个法官下生存. 我们不是假定法官可以互换,而是量化他们的同意,并讨论它意味着解释我们的结果。 设置详见附录C.

blocks.en: Figure 5 reports the pairwise ϕ \phi coefficient over per-sample verdicts, and two observations follow. First, all pairs are positively but only moderately correlated: the judges share a broad consensus on what constitutes a jailbreak, yet disagree on a substantial fraction of individual samples, and even judges of the same style differ. This dispersion cautions against reading any single-judge attack-success rate as ground truth, and motivates our practice of reporting results under multiple judges (Appendix E.3 ). Second, the model’s own Decision label correlates with every external judge at a level comparable to inter-judge agreement, despite the external judges never observing the deliberation that produced it. The committed decision is therefore not an internal artifact decoupled from outcomes: it tracks independent assessments of the final reply, supporting its use as a self-verified training signal in our decision reward.
blocks.zh: 图5报告每例判决的双比=========== 首先,所有对子都是正面的,但只有中度关联:法官对什么是越狱有着广泛的共识,但对相当一部分的个别样本却持不同意见,甚至同一种风格的法官也有所不同。 这种分散做法告诫人们不要将任何单一法官的攻击成功率视为基本事实,并促使我们在多个法官下报告结果的做法(附录E.3)。 第二,该模式本身的裁决标签与每位外部法官相关,其级别相当于法官之间的协议,尽管外部法官从未遵守产生该模式的审议意见。 因此,该承诺决定并非与结果脱钩的内部文物:它跟踪对最后答复的独立评估,支持在裁决奖励中将其用作自我核实的培训信号。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Aligned models now refuse direct harmful requests with high reliability, which has pushed attacks toward the conversational setting: escalation schemes that decompose a harmful goal into individually innocuous turns ( Russinovich et al., 2024 ; Ren et al., 2025 ) , persuasion- and rapport-based strategies ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) , and human red-teaming, which remains markedly more effective than automated attacks ( Li et al., 2024 ) . These attacks succeed without ever posing an overtly harmful query, so single-turn defenses and input filters offer little protection. Our threat model is exactly this setting: scripted multi-turn attacks replayed statically, with adaptive adversaries acknowledged as an open limitation.
blocks.zh: 联合模型现在以高度可靠性拒绝直接的有害请求,这促使攻击转向对话环境:将有害目标分解成个别无害转弯的升级计划(Russinovich等,2024;Ren等,2025;以说服和调节为基础的战略(Zeng等,2024;和人红队),这仍然明显比自动攻击更有效(Li等,2024)。 这些攻击成功时从未产生过明显有害的查询,因此单回合防守和输入过滤器几乎没有提供什么保护. 我们的威胁模式正是这种设定:脚本多回合攻击被静态地重放,适应性的对手被公认为一个开放的限制.

blocks.en: Existing training-based defenses supervise the response: SFT and preference optimization on safe replies ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2025 ) , and RL with a harmfulness classifier or guard model as reward ( Ding et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) . This design imports the judge’s errors into training, entangles the training reward with the evaluation metric, and opens a reward-hacking surface. Representation-level methods instead separate harmful from benign directions in activation space ( Zou et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) . A third line intervenes at inference rather than in the weights, prompting the model to analyse the user’s underlying intention before it answers ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) . That work is the closest in spirit to our assessment step, and the comparison is informative: it obtains its gains from deliberation alone, whereas our ablations show that deliberation without a committed decision recovers little of the defense (§ 3.3 ). Our reward departs from all three: it reads only the model’s committed decision against the conversation’s known label, requiring no model in the loop, and the gradient never reaches the response.
blocks.zh: 现有以训练为主的辩护人监督回应:SFT和对安全回复的首选优化(Jiang等,2024;Yan等,2025;有危害性或警备模式的RL为奖励(Ding等,2025;Guo等,2025). 这种设计将法官的错误输入培训,将培训奖励与评价衡量标准纠缠在一起,并打开了奖励的表面。 相反,在激活空间中,代表级方法与良性方向相分离(Zou等,2024;Lu等,2025)。 第三行介入推论而不是权重,促使模型在回答用户的基本意图之前进行分析(张等,2025b.). 这项工作在精神上最接近我们的评估步骤,而比较是翔实的:它仅从审议中获得收益,而我们的夸夸其谈表明,没有作出坚定决定的审议几乎没有恢复辩护(第3.3节)。 我们的奖励与这三者不同:它只读到模型对对话中已知的标签的坚定决定,不需要任何模型在循环中,梯度也从未达到响应.

blocks.en: A complementary line of work locates the mechanism of these failures: alignment behavior concentrates in the first few output tokens ( Qi et al., 2024a ) , which is why prefilled affirmative openers ( Andriushchenko et al., 2025 ; Vega et al., 2023 ) , decoding-parameter exploits ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , and fine-tuning perturbations of early positions ( Qi et al., 2024b ) defeat refusal. Proposed remedies deepen the alignment, e.g., by augmenting training with recovery-from-harmful-prefix data ( Qi et al., 2024a ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) .
blocks.zh: 互补的一行工作定位了这些失败的机制:对齐行为集中在前几个输出符上(Qi等,2024a),这就是为什么预先填充的正向开口者. (Andriushchenko等,2025;Vega等,2023),解码参数开发(黄等,2024),并微调早期位置的扰动(齐等,2024b)击败拒绝. 拟议的补救办法加深了一致性,例如,通过增加从有害中恢复到前缀的数据的培训(Qi等人,2024a; 张等,2025a. ).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present Assess → \to Decide → \to Respond , a multi-turn defense in which the defender commits to an explicit, parseable safety decision before it replies, trained by reinforcement learning at the payload turn. Rather than repairing shallow alignment, the framework repurposes it: the short span that decides the fate of a response, ordinarily the attacker’s target, becomes a commitment the defender controls. Because the decision is a token span, a rule can reward it against the conversation’s known nature with no judge and no annotation, and the same format also supports a judge-based reward with safe redirection. Across two model families and fourteen benchmarks, our defenders achieve the strongest multi-turn safety in a controlled comparison, hold that lead under six judges, and preserve utility, with over-refusal as the cost. KL analysis, interventional probes, and ablations agree that the defense operates through the committed decision. More broadly, our results suggest that structural properties of alignment, often treated as weaknesses, can be engineered into defenses, and that commitments offer a scalable alternative to judge-based supervision for conversational safety.
blocks.zh: 我们提出评估 \ 决定 \\ \ 答复 ,这是一个多回合防御, 其中捍卫者承诺在答复前作出明确、可解析的安全决定,并在有效载荷转弯处接受强化学习培训。 框架不是修复浅接,而是重新设计:决定反应命运的短距离,通常是攻击者的目标,成为捍卫者控制的承诺。 因为裁决是一个象征性的跨度,所以一个规则可以在没有法官和没有注释的情况下,根据对话的已知性质来奖励它,同样的格式也支持以法官为基础的奖励,并安全地重新定向。 在两个模范家庭和14个基准中,我们的捍卫者通过控制性比较,实现了最强的多回合安全,在6名法官之下占据主导地位,并保持效用,代价是过度反驳。 KL分析,干涉探针,和平滑都同意,防御通过承诺的决定进行操作. 更广泛地说,我们的结果表明,调整的结构性质,常常被视为弱点,可以被设计成防御,而承诺为法官监督对话安全提供了可扩展的替代办法。

blocks.en: Appendix A Shallow Alignment Experiments
blocks.zh: 附录A 浅接实验

blocks.en: This section verifies by direct intervention that our framework achieves what it was designed for: leveraging shallow alignment rather than suffering from it. Shallow alignment concentrates safety behavior at a few trajectory-setting positions, which is ordinarily a vulnerability because those positions can be overwritten or sampled past ( Qi et al., 2024a ) . Our framework deliberately relocates this concentration into an explicit, trained decision, and the probes below confirm that the relocation works as intended: the committed decision is a causal control point rather than a correlate, training strengthens both the commitment and the reply behind it, and the sampling route that ordinarily defeats shallow alignment is closed. We adapt three diagnostics from Qi et al. (2024a) : the refusal-prefix shortcut, the prefilling attack, and the decoding-parameter exploit.
blocks.zh: 本节通过直接干预证实,我们的框架实现了它所设计的目标:利用浅度的配合而不是因此而受苦受难。 浅色对接将安全行为集中在几个设定轨迹的位置上,这通常是一种脆弱性,因为这些位置可以被覆盖或取样过去(Qi等人,2024a)。 我们的框架有意将这种集中化为一个明确、训练有素的决定,下面的探测器证实迁移是按预期进行的:承诺的决定是一个因果控制点,而不是一个关联点,训练既加强了承诺,也加强了背后的答复,通常会挫败浅调的取样路线是封闭的。 我们调整了Qi等人(2024a)的三项诊断: 拒绝-前缀快捷键、预填攻击和解码参数开发。

blocks.en: Every arm of Table 1 appears in both its unaligned form (the base weights under the framework prompt, untrained) and its aligned form (trained). The unaligned arm is the reference: it emits a well-formed Decision line by instruction-following alone, so the decision can be read and overwritten exactly as in a trained model, and any gap between the two is attributable to training rather than prompting. Both probes use the held-out SEMA/AdvBench payload turns ( n = 104 n=104 ); verdicts come from gpt-5-mini , the Table 1 judge.
blocks.zh: 表1的每个分支都以不相通的形式(框架下的基准权重迅速而未经训练)和相通的形式(训练)出现。 不相通的臂膀是参考:它通过单独遵循指令来发出一个完善的决定线,因此可以像在训练有素的模型中那样完全读取和重写决定,两者间的任何差距都归因于训练而不是催促. 两种探测器都使用被搁置的SEMA/Adv Bench有效载荷转弯(n = 104 n = 104);判决来自表1判断器gpt-5-mini.

blocks.en: A.1 Is the Decision a Cause?
blocks.zh: A.1 该决定是原因吗?

blocks.en: The forced-decision probe (Figure 6 , left) replaces the payload-turn deliberation with a canonical one ending in a chosen label and generates only the reply, the interventional counterpart to the observational KL analysis. Follow-through is exact by construction: the emitted label matched the forced one in every cell.
blocks.zh: 强制决定探测器(图6,左取)将有效载荷-转动的考虑取而代之,取而代之的是用所选择的标签结尾的犬形物体,只生成答复,即观测KL分析的干预对应. 跟踪通过构造是准确的:排放的标签与每个牢房的强制标签相符。

blocks.en: Two findings point in opposite directions, and together they locate exactly what training contributes. First, the refusal shortcut reproduces in decision form. Forcing refuse lifts the unaligned model to perfect safety on both backbones, with genuine refusals rather than empty turns: a supplied commitment makes an untrained model behave as aligned, with a parseable label in place of a surface prefix. The model’s ability to honor it is inherited from instruction-following, which is exactly the shallowness our framework leverages. Second, training does not merely select the label. Were that so, forcing comply would return the aligned models to unaligned harm. Instead they stay high: the unaligned arms collapse under a forced comply while every aligned arm remains far above its unaligned counterpart, with Self reward (aligned) on Llama essentially indistinguishable from its natural decoding. Training therefore hardens the reply as well as the commitment. The component ablation in § 3.3 reaches the same conclusion by removal rather than by intervention: a defender trained without the Decision line gives up most of its robustness, while one trained without the assessment gives up comparatively little.
blocks.zh: 两项调查结果表明,它们的方向相反,它们合在一起,可以确切地确定培训的贡献。 首先,拒绝的快捷方式以决定的形式复制。 强制拒绝可以提升不相通的模型来完善两根骨干上的安全性,真正拒绝而不是空转:提供的承诺使得一个未经训练的模型表现为对齐,一个可解析的标签代替了表面前缀. 这个模型的能耐来自于遵循指示, 这正是我们框架的杠杆。 第二,培训不仅仅是选择标签。 如果是这样的话,强制遵守会使联合模式重新受到不协调的损害。 相反,它们居高临下:不结盟的武器在强制遵守下崩溃,而每个结盟的臂膀都远远高于不结盟的臂膀,在Llama问题上的自我奖励(结盟)基本上与它的自然解码密不可分。 因此,培训使答复和承诺更加坚定。 第3.3节中的内容删减通过撤走而不是干预得出同样的结论:没有决定线而接受过培训的维权者放弃了大部分的稳健性,而未经评估而接受过培训的维权者则相对很少放弃。

blocks.en: A.2 How Deep Is the Protection?
blocks.zh: A.2 保护有多深?

blocks.en: The depth probe (Figure 6 , right) concedes the decision and attacks what follows: after a forced refuse , it prefills the first k k tokens of a genuine harmful reply and continues generation, relocating the prefilling attack past the commitment ( k = 0 k=0 recovers the forced- refuse condition above). The unaligned arms are textbook shallow: a handful of prefilled tokens erases most of the safety the commitment secured, and the curve stays flat thereafter. Training buys substantial post-decision depth on Llama, where the aligned curve stays high at shallow prefill and decays gradually, but only marginal depth on Qwen3, where the aligned and unaligned curves converge at larger k k . Every curve decays eventually, which is the expected signature of a defense that is shallow by construction: the protection is procedural and does not survive an adversary who can write arbitrarily far into the assistant channel. Such an adversary lies outside our threat model, which grants control of user turns only; the right panel quantifies that boundary rather than leaving it as a caveat.
blocks.zh: 深度探测器(图6,右)承认决定和攻击以下内容:在强制拒绝之后,它预先填充了第一个K K 表示真正有害的答复并持续生成,将预填攻击移出承诺(k = 0 k = 0 恢复上述强制拒绝条件). 不结盟的武器是教科书上很浅的:少数预先填入的标志会抹去大部分安全性的承诺,此后曲线会保持平平. 训练在Llama上购买了相当的判定后深度,在Llama上,对齐曲线在浅预填时会保持高位并逐渐衰变,但在Qun3上只有边缘深度,对齐和不对齐曲线会以更大的k k相会合. 每道曲线最终会衰败,这是一个通过构造而浅薄的防御的预期标志:保护是程序性的,无法从一个能够任意地将文字写入助理通道的对手中幸存下来. 这种对手不在我们的威胁模式之外,这种模式只允许控制用户;正确的面板将这一边界量化,而不是留作警告。

blocks.en: A.3 Can Sampling Dislodge the Commitment?
blocks.zh: A.3. 取样 放弃承诺?

blocks.en: A third probe runs the decoding-parameter exploit, which defeats shallow alignment by sampling alone. For each harmful behavior we draw twelve samples across a grid of temperature, top- p p , and top- k k on direct single-turn AdvBench requests ( 1,248 1{,}248 samples per arm), plus a greedy generation defining the committed decision, and record the decision-flip rate : the fraction of samples whose label departs from that commitment. Absolute attack success is low for every arm (at most 9 % 9\,\% any-of- N N ), since our base is already an instruction-tuned chat model rather than the pretrained bases the exploit was designed against; the informative quantity is therefore behavior conditional on the sampled label. Within the unaligned Llama it is unambiguous: the few samples that flipped to comply were judged jailbroken about two-thirds of the time, against effectively zero for those that stayed refuse . Sampling occasionally dislodges the commitment and the reply follows it, the same mechanism as in § A.1 made visible by chance rather than by intervention. The aligned arms, in contrast, never sample a comply label (at most 0.2 % 0.2\,\% of flips): training closes the sampling route by which shallow alignment is ordinarily defeated. The one large flip rate we observe, 20 20 – 30 % 30\,\% on the Qwen3 three-label arms, is not a safety event: every such flip exchanges the two defensible labels ( refuse ↔ \leftrightarrow safe-redirect ), none reaches comply , and attack success stays at zero. Therefore, we conclude that sampling merely surfaces the decision-space ambiguity without compromising safety.
blocks.zh: 第三个探测器运行了解码参数开发,仅通过取样就击败了浅接. 对于每一个有害的行为,我们绘制12个样本 跨越一个温度网格,顶-p-p, 和顶-k-k 直接单转 Adv Bench 请求(1,248 1{,}248个样本每臂), 加上一个贪婪的一代 定义承诺的决定, 并记录决定-滑行率: 其标签偏离承诺的样本分数。 每只手臂的绝对攻击成功率都很低(最多为9%-9%-9%-%-%-任何N-N),因为我们的基地已经是一个指令调制的聊天模式,而不是开发时所设计的预先训练的基地;因此,信息量取决于抽样标签的行为。 在不结盟的Llama内部,这是毫不含糊的:少数被推翻遵守的样本在大约三分之二的时间里被判定为监禁,而那些留下来的拒绝者实际上为零。 抽样偶尔会转移承诺,随即提出答复,与第A.1节中的机制一样,是偶然的,而不是干预的。 相形之下,对齐的武器从未抽取过遵守标签(最多为0.2%. 0.2%.%.):训练关闭了通常会击败浅接的取样路线。 我们观察到的一个大翻转率,20 20 — 30 % — 30 % — — 在Qwen3 三标签臂上,不是一个安全事件:每一次这样的翻转交换两个可防守的标签(拒绝\\\\ 左右转), 都达不到要求,攻击成功保持在0。 因此,我们的结论是,取样只是显示决策空间的模糊性而不损害安全。

The vertical axis reports safety as the mean SAFE % over AdvBench and MHJ: the former is out-of-domain in data but in-domain in attack style, while the latter, composed of human-crafted jailbreaks, is out-of-domain in both and empirically the hardest suite, so together they span the generalization spectrum without letting saturated benchmarks inflate the score. The horizontal axis aggregates helpfulness as 1 2 ​ [ ( 100 − XSTest ) + 10 × MT ​ - ​ Bench ] \tfrac{1}{2}\left[(100-\mathrm{XSTest})+10\times\mathrm{MT\text{-}Bench}\right] , where 100 − XSTest 100-\mathrm{XSTest} converts over-refusal into a compliance rate and MT-Bench is rescaled to [ 0,100 ] [0,100] ; higher is better on both axes. Stars denote our two reward variants and gray circles the baselines.

blocks.en: The visualization makes the structure of the results immediate. On Llama3.1-8B the baselines cluster in a narrow band of the plane: they occupy similar helpfulness levels yet differ little in safety, indicating that existing defenses move along the helpfulness axis without meaningfully climbing the safety axis. Our two variants separate cleanly from this cluster, occupying the upper region at helpfulness comparable to the baselines rather than trading one axis for the other. On Qwen3-8B the retuned baselines spread out along the safety axis instead of clustering, and the strongest of them approach our operating region; what distinguishes our variants there is that they reach it without the per-method corrections catalogued in § 3 , and they do so at lower over-refusal than MTSA, the closest baseline on the safety axis. The two variants do not, however, relate to each other consistently across backbones. On Qwen3-8B the self-verified reward is the safer and less helpful of the two, as one would expect from a reward that checks a committed label; on Llama3.1-8B the ordering reverses on both axes, with the external reward safer (92.9 versus 90.4 average SAFE %) and less helpful (MT-Bench 5.21 versus 5.86). The two therefore span a frontier the baselines do not reach, but which of them occupies which end is backbone-dependent, and our experiments do not isolate why: the rewards differ both in what they read and in whether a judge is in the loop, and the two backbones differ in whether a native reasoning channel precedes the decision. We flag this as an open question rather than an operating-point choice a practitioner could make a priori.
blocks.zh: 这种可视化使结果的结构成为即时的. 在Llama3.1-8B上,平面上一个狭长的波段的基线集群:它们具有相似的有用性水平,但在安全性上却差别不大,表明现有的防御工事沿着有用性轴移动而不会有意义地爬上安全轴. 我们的两个变体与这个组别毫不相干地分开,占据了上层区域,具有与基线相当的有用性,而不是将一个轴对另一个轴进行交易。 在Qwen3-8B上,重新调整的基线沿着安全轴向外分出,而不是集群,其中最强者走近我们的操作区域;区别于我们的变体是,它们到达时没有第3节中编目的每方法校正,它们是在比安全轴上最接近的MTSA更低的反射量下达到的. 然而,这两个变体之间并非始终如一地相互关联。 在Qwen3-8B上,自我核实的奖励是两者中更安全和帮助较少的奖励,因为人们会期望从检查已承诺的标签的奖励中获得;在Llama3.1-8B上,两轴上的订单倒置,外部奖励更安全(92.9比90.4平均SAFE%),帮助较少(MT-Bench 5.21比5.86). 因此,两者跨越一个边界,基线无法到达,但其中哪一个占据了哪一个终点是骨干依赖的,而我们的实验并不孤立为什么:在阅读内容和法官是否处于循环中,奖励是不同的,两个骨干在裁决之前是否有一个本土推理渠道是不同的。 我们将此视为一个未决问题,而不是从业者可以预先作出的操作点选择。

blocks.en: Appendix C Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 细节

blocks.en: All defenders are trained with GRPO in verl ( Sheng et al., 2024 ) , driven by a custom multi-turn agent loop registered through verl’s agent-loop interface. We train two backbones independently, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B; Qwen3 is trained with its native reasoning channel enabled, so each turn contains the model’s own <think> block in addition to the scaffold’s output, while Llama-3.1 has no such channel. The policy is a LoRA adapter rather than a full fine-tune (rank 32, α = 32 \alpha=32 , all linear modules), optimized with Adam at learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} under FSDP2 with gradient checkpointing. We apply a KL penalty toward the frozen reference policy with coefficient 0.001 using the low-variance estimator, and set the entropy bonus to zero. Rollouts are generated by vLLM in asynchronous mode with tensor parallelism 1 and 60% of GPU memory reserved for the rollout engine; the adapter is hot-swapped into the engine between updates, so no weight merge is needed during training.
blocks.zh: 所有维权者都接受verl的GRPO培训(Sheng等,2024年),通过verl的代理-loop接口注册的自定义多回合代理循环驱动. 我们独立地训练两个骨干,Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qune3-8B;Qune3是用其本土推理通道被启用来训练的,因此每个转弯除了脚手架的输出之外还包含模型自己的"想"块,而Llama-3.1则没有这样的通道. 政策是LORA适配器,而不是完全微调(排名32,α = 32\alpha=32,全部为线性模块),在FSDP2下以学习率10−4 10^{-4}与亚当进行优化并进行梯度检查. 我们用低变量估计系数0.00系数对冻结参考政策适用KL处罚,并将等值奖金设定为零。 滚出由vLLM在同步模式下生成,与拉伸并行主义1和60%的GPU内存保留用于滚出引擎;适配器在更新之间被热分到引擎中去,因此在训练期间不需要重量合并.

blocks.en: Each training row is a complete, pre-generated multi-turn attack dialogue, so the attacker is fixed and only the defender is learned. A rollout replays the scripted attacker turns one at a time, and after each the policy generates one full turn capped at 2048 tokens. Generated tokens are appended to the running context and marked trainable; injected attacker turns are appended with mask 0, so no gradient flows through text the policy did not produce. Rollouts run to at most 7 defender turns, with a 1024-token prompt budget and a 12,288-token response budget inside a 14,336-token model window. We draw n = 16 n=16 rollouts per prompt, a size dictated by the binary reward: GRPO normalizes advantages within each prompt group, so a group whose rollouts all emit the same label has zero variance and contributes no gradient, and a large group is what maintains within-group label diversity.
blocks.zh: 每个训练行都是完整的,预先产生的多回合攻击对话,因此攻击者是固定的,只有捍卫者才被学习. 出道后再回放被脚本攻击者一次翻出一回,每回政策后会产生一回被封入2048令牌的全回转. 生成的令牌被附加在运行的上下文上并被标记为可训练;被注入的攻击者转弯被附加了口罩0,因此没有通过文本的梯度流策略没有产生. 运行到最多7个维护者转弯,在14 336个模型窗口内有一个1024个托肯快速预算和12 288个托肯响应预算. 我们绘制 n = 16 n = 16 推出时,大小由二进制奖励决定: GRPO使每个提示组内部的优势正常化,所以一个组的展开全部发出同一种标签的相差为零,没有贡献梯度,一个大组就是维持组内标签多样性的.

blocks.en: We compare seven verdict sources on our Qwen3-8B defender (two-label scaffold, self-verified decision reward): gpt-5-mini ( Singh et al., 2025 ) , gpt-oss-20b ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) , StrongREJECT ( Souly et al., 2024 ) , Llama-Guard-3-8B ( Llama Team, 2024 ) , Qwen3Guard ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , HarmBench-13B ( Mazeika et al., 2024 ) , and the model’s own committed Decision label. The pool covers all thirteen held-out multi-turn safety cells: five attack families (SEMA, Crescendo, FITD, Echo, HIS) on both AdvBench and HarmBench, plus MHJ, CoSafe and MultiBreak, in total 3738 dialogues. Each source reduces a dialogue to a single binary jailbroken verdict on the final turn. Critically, the six external judges see only the user-facing reply, with the assessment/Decision deliberation stripped.

blocks.en: Appendix D Prompts
blocks.zh: 附录D 提示

blocks.en: Figure 8 shows the two Assess → \to Decide → \to Respond system prompts verbatim. Both instruct the defender to precede every reply with an open, untagged deliberation of exactly two lines, an Intent line assessing the user’s underlying goal and its potential for harm, and a Decision line committing to a label, followed by a reply consistent with that decision. The prompts differ only in the label menu and the matching clause of the closing instruction. The two-label variant accompanies the self-verified reward: because that reward checks the emitted label against the row’s known ground truth, every admissible label must have one, and safe-redirect does not. The three-label variant is therefore usable only with an external reward that scores the reply itself, where a hedging option is meaningful. Neither prompt wraps the deliberation in tags; on a backbone with a native reasoning channel, this keeps the <think> block unambiguously the model’s own and the framework cleanly separable from it.
blocks.zh: 图8显示两个评估 \\ 决定 \\\ 按系统逐字提示。 既指示辩护方在每一份答复之前,应公开、不加标记地审议确切的两行,一行是意向线,评估用户的基本目标及其可能造成的伤害,一行是决定线,承诺贴上标签,然后是符合该决定的答复。 提示仅在标签菜单和收尾指令的匹配条款上有所不同. 双标签的变体伴有自我验证的奖励:因为奖励对照行内已知的地面真相检查所发放的标签,每个可受理的标签必须有一个,而安全指示不是。 因此,三个标签的变体只有在对答复本身进行评分的外部奖励下才能使用,其中套期选择是有意义的。 无论是快速还是快速的,都无法用标签来结束审议;在一个具有本土推理渠道的骨干上,这可以使“思考”块毫不含糊地将模型本身和框架与它明确分开。

blocks.en: E.1 Utility

blocks.en: Table 2 breaks the utility average of Table 1 down by benchmark. The pattern is uniform: on both backbones, every method, including ours, stays within a narrow band of its base model on every task, and no benchmark shows a systematic degradation attributable to safety training. What variation exists is concentrated in the instruction-following suite, the one task most sensitive to chat behavior, while the knowledge- and reasoning-centric benchmarks are essentially untouched. This is the expected signature of the evaluation protocol discussed in § 3 : these suites are scored as plain-text completion without the chat template, so they bypass both the scaffold and the shallow, format-concentrated component of safety training, and confirm that our intervention leaves the underlying capabilities of the model intact.

blocks.en: We report the precision of Table 1 against the sampling noise of the evaluation: Table 3 restates every cell of Table 1 with a 95% confidence interval. Each safety cell is a SAFE rate over n n held-out dialogues ( n = 516 n=516 , 785 785 , 500 500 , 1400 1400 , and 537 537 for Adv., Harm., MB, CoS., and MHJ respectively; 3,738 3{,}738 in total), with one exception: the Llama3.1-8B Base MHJ cell is scored over 300 300 dialogues, and its wider interval reflects that, so its sampling error is that of a binomial proportion; we report the 95% Wilson interval as a half-width, and a behavior-clustered bootstrap interval for the pooled Avg. Over-refusal (XSTest, XSB) carries Wilson intervals ( n = 250 n=250 , 340 340 ), and MT-Bench a 95% t t -interval over its 160 160 per-turn scores. Utility is the mean of six lm-eval tasks; since lm-eval reports an independent standard error per task, the mean carries a combined half-width of about one point.

blocks.en: Three trends follow from the intervals. First, the safety conclusions are resolved unevenly, and the intervals are worth reading before the point estimates. The clearest case is the self-verified reward on Qwen3-8B : its average exceeds MUSE-D, the strongest baseline by average, by nearly nine half-widths, and its interval is disjoint from MUSE-D’s on all five suites. That is a statement about MUSE-D specifically. On MHJ — the hardest suite and the one most worth scrutinising — the self-verified interval ( 75.2 ± 3.6 75.2\pm 3.6 ) overlaps MTSA’s ( 70.9 ± 3.8 70.9\pm 3.8 ), so on that suite the two are not separated even though the point estimates differ by four points. The external reward on the same backbone is a different matter — its average lead is under two half-widths and its per-suite intervals overlap the strongest baseline’s on every suite, so on that backbone the two should be read as comparable rather than ordered. On Llama3.1-8B both variants clear the strongest baseline on average, but the per-suite intervals overlap X-Boundary’s on AdvBench for both, and on MultiBreak and MHJ for the self-verified variant. What the intervals support throughout is the separation between our variants and the field of baselines, not a resolved ordering against the single strongest one on every suite. Second, the Utility column is indistinguishable across methods: every entry lies within roughly one combined interval of its base model, confirming that no method, ours included, meaningfully changes capability. Third, the helpfulness intervals counsel asymmetric reading: they are wide relative to the small method-to-method differences on XSTest and MT-Bench, which should therefore not be over-interpreted, whereas the elevated over-refusal of the aligned defenders relative to their base models clears the intervals comfortably and is a real cost rather than noise.
blocks.zh: 间隔期呈现出三种趋势。 首先,安全结论的解决不均匀,间隔值在点数估计之前值得读取. 最清楚的例子是Qwen3-8B上的自我验证的奖励:平均超过MUSE-D, 平均比最强的基准, 这是关于MUSE-D的声明。 在MHJ——最难的套房和最值得检查的套房——上,自我验证的间隔(75.2±3.6 75.2\pm 3.6)与MTSA的相重叠(70.9±3.8 70.9\pm 3.8),因此,尽管点数估计有四分之差,但两者并没有分开。 同一个骨干上的外部奖励是一个不同的问题——它的平均领先率不到两分之一,而且它的每套间距与每个套房最强的基准值相重叠,因此在骨干上,两者应该被解读为可比的而不是订购. 在Llama3.1-8B上,两个变体平均都明确了最强的基准,但每套时间间隔与Adv Bench上的X-Bondary重叠,而MultiBreak和MHJ上的自验证变体重叠。 我们的变体与基线领域之间的分离 并不是每个套房最强的单项订单 第二,通用栏是无法区分的方法的:每个条目都位于其基础模型的大约一个综合间隔内,证实没有任何方法,包括我们的方法,有意义地改变能力。 第三,实用性间隔咨询非对称读法:相对于XSTest和MT-Bench方法上的细微差异而言,其范围很广,因此不应过度解释,而联合维权者相对于其基本模型而言,其高度的过度反驳则可以舒适地澄清间隔,是一种真正的成本而不是噪音。

blocks.en: Table 4 reports safety under five additional judges, all held out from training. The two rewards behave differently here, and the distinction matters. The self-verified reward places first or second in all 25 judge-by-benchmark cells on Qwen3-8B , and is the strict maximum in 22 of them. The three exceptions are CoSafe under Llama-Guard-3, where all four of our rows tie at 100.0 100.0 ; CoSafe under HarmBench-13B, where our external variant is marginally ahead ( 96.9 96.9 against 96.4 96.4 ); and MHJ under Qwen3Guard, the one cell in the panel where a baseline leads it (MTSA, 81.8 81.8 against 78.8 78.8 ). The external reward is not comparably robust: it falls outside the top two in 9 of the 25 cells, ranking third or fourth on MHJ under every judge and third or fourth on AdvBench and HarmBench under Qwen3Guard. Claims about judge-independence should therefore be made for the self-verified reward specifically. The baselines also reorder among themselves — MUSE-D leads MTSA under gpt-oss-20b, StrongREJECT and HarmBench-13B, and the two swap under Llama-Guard-3 and Qwen3Guard — so what the judges agree on is the position of the self-verified reward relative to the field, not a total ordering. The lead is also narrower than the ranking implies: averaged over the five judges the self-verified reward exceeds the strongest baseline by + 7.1 +7.1 on MultiBreak but only + 2.6 +2.6 on MHJ and + 3.2 +3.2 on CoSafe, and on CoSafe under Llama-Guard-3 the margin is + 0.1 +0.1 with both our variants at 100.0 100.0 . The judges do differ in absolute calibration, with some scoring systematically stricter or more lenient than others, which is consistent with the moderate inter-judge agreement quantified in § 4.2 ; crucially, however, these shifts move all methods together and leave the ranking essentially unchanged. Since our reward never consults any of these judges, this consistency indicates that the measured gains reflect genuinely safer behavior rather than overfitting to the idiosyncrasies of a particular evaluator.
blocks.zh: 表4显示,新增5名法官的安全情况,均不经过培训。 这两个奖赏在这里表现不同,区别很重要. 自我验证的奖励在Qwen3-8B上的所有25个裁判分数单元中位居第一或第二,是其中22个的严格上限. 三个例外是:Llama-Guard-3下的CoSafe,我们的四行均以100:00:100:00;Harm Bench-13B下的CoSafe,我们的外部变体略为领先(96.9:96.9:96.4:96.4;Qune3Guard下的MHJ,这是小组中一个以基线为准的单元(MTSA,81.8:8:78.8:78.8:88)。 外部奖励不相上下:在25个格中的9个格中处于前2名之外,在MHJ上名列第3名或第4名,在每位裁判下名列第3名或第4名;在Adv Bench和Harm Bench上名列第3名;在Qune3Guard下名列第4名. 因此,应具体要求自我核实的奖赏。 基线也相互间重新排序——MUSE-D在gpt-oss-20b,StrongREJECT和Harm Bench-13B下领导MTSA,在Llama-Guard-3和Qun3Guard下的两个互换——因此法官们同意的是相对于球场的自我验证奖励的位置,而不是完全命令. 领先程度也比排名所隐含的要窄:在5名法官中,经自我核实的奖励平均超过最强基线,在MultiBreak上为+7.1+7.1,但在MHJ上为+2.6+2.6,在CoSafe上为+3.2+3.2,在Llama-Guard-3下为CoSafe,比值为+0.1+0.1,我们的变数均为100.00.0.0. 法官在绝对校准方面确实有所不同,有些评分系统严格或比其他评分更宽大,这符合第4.2节中量化的温和法官间协议;然而,关键是,这些分级将所有方法结合在一起,排名基本保持不变。 由于我们的奖励从未征求过任何一位法官的意见,这种一致性表明,所衡量的收益反映了真正更加安全的行为,而不是过于符合某一评估者的典型。
